content.short: A Cardano focused multi-chain decentralized presale platform, an IDO platform, an incubator and accelerator.
content.description: Cardence is a decentralized presale platform and IDO launchpad for new projects on Cardano. Its mission is to facilitate token presales in a trustless and permissionless way, giving teams tools to launch while giving communities access to early opportunities. The platform is designed so projects with Cardano native tokens can create presales without relying on a centralized gatekeeper. Cardence fits the ecosystem as launch infrastructure for fundraising, incubation, and project discovery across early-stage teams.
